$comment: Single source of truth for Krypton's look. tools/gen_tokens.py turns this into C++ (and later Swift). Colors are #AARRGGBB or #RRGGBB. Sizes are DIPs. A "$type" names the generated struct so sibling objects can share one type. Zen source values and Krypton adaptations are documented in docs/zen-reference.md.

windowConstraints.$comment: Existing shared layout threshold, moved from kMinCardWidth; no new geometry.

horizontalTabs.$comment: Address widths and reduction steps from ui/layout/compact.patch and centered-address-bar.patch. Tab widths from the Krypton host tab strip: chrome/browser/ui/tabs/tab_style.cc (232 DIP standard tab excluding separators and overlap; pinned tabs are 64 DIP including the two 12 DIP corner extensions; the active minimum fits a 16 DIP favicon between 8 DIP kTabHorizontalPadding insets; inactive tabs shrink to a 16 DIP interior) and views/tabs/tab.cc (inactive close buttons need 68 DIP of content).

loadingProgress.$comment: Recovered four-layer composition: radial-masked gradient and shimmer behind their thin edge copies. Visible colors come from the active theme.

workspaceFooter.$comment: zen/spaces/zen-workspaces.css: toolbarbutton max-width/height 30px, gap 3px, icon font-size 12px. Workspace symbols use the scheme's monochrome workspaceIcon foreground.

appMenu.$comment: zen/common/styles/zen-popup.css: arrowpanel menuitem padding/margins, 16px icons, icon margin and zoom-control padding. Width and height are measured from content and capped by the current XamlRoot.

clearTabs.$comment: Zen vertical-tabs.css .pinned-tabs-container-separator toolbarbutton: a 10px weight-500 label with the 10px dart-down icon 2px after it and 8px start padding. Hidden until the sidebar is hovered, then at half opacity, and opaque while hovered, fading over 0.15s.

actionBadge.$comment: Zen's extension badge: toolkit/themes/shared/toolbarbutton.css .toolbarbutton-badge with tokens-shared.css --toolbarbutton-badge-*. Bold 10px text at line-height 1, padding 0 2px 1px, 14-20px wide, 2px radius, white text, offset 5px up and 4px past the 16px icon's end.

siteDataMenu.$comment: Zen zen-single-components.css: 234px panel, 48x32 action tiles, 8px gaps, 16px extension icons and 18px page icons. Section and footer spacing follows the site-data panel.

browserTools.$comment: Native browser service windows: Chromium task_manager_view and site settings structure, composed with WinUI controls. All values are DIPs.

workspaceSwipe.$comment: Touchpad-only sidebar gestures. Distances are DIPs; completion, including inertia, releases the one-switch latch. No idle timer.

menu.$comment: Geometry follows the XAML recreation's MenuFlyoutPresenter. Native popup backdrop: acrylic, mica, or solid. Light/dark fallback surfaces follow zen-theme.css --arrowpanel-background.

overlay.$comment: Floating input and results: zen-omnibox.css; width and vertical centering: ZenUIManager.mjs. topOffset is retained only for the preview host's existing minimum-window calculation.

themeEditor.$comment: ZenGradientGenerator.mjs, zen-gradient-generator.css and theme-picker.inc. Source CSS rem units use the native type.size token. Point geometry is normalized against the reference's 358-DIP board. controlsCard* follows the supplied rounded bottom-card reference.

workspaceGradient.$comment: ZenGradientGenerator.mjs::getGradient. Every chrome surface uses these layers in the same window-client coordinates.

tabHover.$comment: Minimal hover card: title/domain header, edge-to-edge 16:9 thumbnail and a plain memory footer, following the supplied reference image. Existing card typography, padding, width and radius are retained. Timing from the Krypton host's chrome/browser/ui/views/tabs/hovercard/tab_hover_card_controller.cc: a 300-800 ms delay on a logarithmic scale of the widest tab between pinned and standard widths (sidebar: collapsed and default widths), 500 ms more at the standard width, and no delay within 300 ms of an open card. tab_hover_card_bubble_view.cc draws the 64 DIP globe when no preview exists.

library.$comment: zen/library/zen-library.css and ZenLibrary.mjs. Width clamps 418px..95% of the client; the side rail is 110px; non-space sections cap at 418-110px. Tabs: 8px margin, 16px block padding, 4px icon gap, 10px radius, 28px icons, currentColor 5% hover and 10% active. Pills: currentColor 7%, 12% hover. Side: rgba(255,255,255,.08) gradient and a 9px 0 17px rgba(0,0,0,.04) shadow. Spring: stiffness 720, damping 47, mass 1.2, as damping ratio and undamped period. The opt-in card uses 6px insets, 22/22/18px padding, 22px radius, 15px bold title, 13px body at 1.45 line height and 85% opacity, 40px icon, 11px note at 60% opacity with a 13px lock and 6px gap, and a rgb(250,250,252)/rgb(28,29,33) surface with 6% outline and 0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.45) shadow. zen-buttons.css .zen-big-accent-button: 12px radius, 1.2rem block and 1rem inline padding, 1.2rem semibold text; accent lightness is clamped to OKLCH 0.35..0.6 (light) and 0.55..0.7 (dark); --zen-accent-button-color, the sprites' stroke, to 0.35..0.6 and 0.7..0.85, with fills 60% toward white/black. Sprites: 36 frames; tabs play over 0.583s on selection; the 18px library button sprite (scaled 1.08) plays forward over 0.35s on hover and back over 0.3s. Media grid: 110px tiles, 12px gap, 6px padding, 16px tile radius, 14px tile padding, 8px thumbnail radius, 1.04 hover scale, 34px play badge with 9px padding.

iconPacks.$comment: Swappable chrome icons (design/icons/packs). A pack or icon change crossfades: the old shape fades and shrinks while the new one grows in, on the compositor, following Fluent's fast-out-slow-in curve. Windows reduced motion and high contrast swap instantly. Pack glyphs sit inside padded boxes, so a tab's close icon is drawn at 12px where the Segoe glyph used 10px.

downloadStack.$comment: zen/common/styles/zen-library-widget.css and ZenLibraryWidget.sys.mjs. Four newest entries, 52px tall, 16px radius, 0 4px padding, 4px gap and 10px top padding. Entries rise 25px and fade in over 0.22s with linear(0, .34 12%, .7 24%, .93 38%, 1.03 55%, 1), 12ms apart from the newest. The stack opens over 0.3s with cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) and closes 200ms after the pointer leaves. Badges: finished 20px pictures scaled 2x with a 2px radius; pending 25px circles with a 3px border, 3px ring and 6px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.1) shadow, 8px start and 20px (pending 15px) end margins. Titles 10pt at 90%, subtitles 8pt at 60%; the action is 28px with a 4px end margin. The library button's badge sits at 14px,-8px and scales to 0.8 while downloading. The tab list fades over an 80px ramp and overshoots by 10px.

mediaControls.$comment: zen/media/zen-media-controls.css and ZenMediaController.mjs. Up to three cards, newest in front; two peek levels 8px apart with a 6px gap, each scaling 4% smaller and 30% more transparent. Cards: 4px 6px padding, 8px radius (border-radius-medium without squircles), 1px rgba(255,255,255,.1) dark outline, 0 0 6px shadow, primary 5% over white/black. Hover reveals the title row and 4px progress row over 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1) from 1rem below. Buttons: 26px with 5px padding and 5px radius; playback group at most 10em; 0.7rem control gap; times are x-small at 70%. Cards reveal 1s after playback starts; durations of 900000s or more hide the position row; the stack hides in the collapsed sidebar.

compact.$comment: ZenCompactMode.mjs, compact-mode/sidebar.inc.css and zen-compact-mode.css. Hover checks are deferred one UI-loop turn; the sidebar retains hover for 150 ms and the toolbar has no additional grace period. Floating bars keep an 8px separation (half at vertical edges), or 10px with page padding disabled, a rounded inner surface and a 1px rgba(255,255,255,.15) outline. Radius and native shadow padding/blur/color adapt Zen's inner-radius calculation and --zen-big-shadow (0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.24)) to WinUI islands.

motion.$comment: Restrained native brush and opacity transitions, following the WinUI Gallery ImplicitTransition samples. Windows reduced motion and high contrast override enabled. fastMs controls hover/popup content; normalMs controls settings section content.

onboarding.$comment: First-run onboarding over the real window. Zen welcome sources at the commit pinned in docs/zen-reference.md: zen-welcome.css (surfaces, type, cards), zen-buttons.css (.zen-big-accent-button), ZenWelcome.mjs (motion), ZenGradientGenerator.mjs and ZenSpaceManager.mjs (springs). rem values use the native type.size token, as themeEditor does. Springs are stored as a damping ratio and an undamped period, derived from Motion v13's visualDuration/bounce rules (period = 1.2 x visualDuration, ratio = 1 - bounce) or from stiffness/damping/mass. Values marked Krypton-own in docs/onboarding-reference.md have no Zen counterpart.

mark.$comment: Krypton's product_logo.svg (resources/core/branding in the Krypton host): viewBox 127.05 105.45 1011.7 1011.7, three round-capped strokes over a white backplate, each with its userSpaceOnUse linear gradient. The strokes draw during Zen's 800 ms lead-in before the title, each over cardFadeMs.

type.iconFamily: Segoe Fluent Icons, Segoe MDL2 Assets

notification.$comment: Zen zen-popup.css toast: top opposite sidebar, 6px padding, 42px height, 14px radius; ZenToasts.mjs 2000ms lifetime. Theme brushes and Windows motion/contrast preferences apply.

workspacePicker.$comment: Native icon/emoji chooser with searchable tiles, following ZenEmojiPicker separation. Fluent symbol glyphs and Unicode emoji preserve the existing workspace glyph contract.

splitView.$comment: Bounded native split-row chrome, chooser and browser page controls. Geometry is final before compositor motion. outlineWidth: zen-split-view.css draws a 2px outline round the selected pane only, in the primary color with HSL lightness lowered 20 points in light schemes and unchanged in dark ones (outlineLightDarken).

downloadArrival.$comment: Finite Library destination feedback based on ZenDownloadAnimation and zen-download-box-animation.css (42px box, 12px radius, 24px icon, 0.45 landing scale). Compositor only; disabled by Windows motion/high contrast.

glance.$comment: Zen reference/desktop/src/zen/glance/zen-glance.css and ZenGlanceManager.mjs: 80% full-height card, 34px round buttons, 12px padding/gap, 350ms entrance, parent scale 0.97 and opacity 0.3; zen-big-shadow and zen-buttons.css. Native easing approximates the spring without resizing pages. Krypton genie-lamp motion uses three compositor transform keyframes: a small source, a bent narrow neck, and the full card; no captured page images or per-frame bounds changes.

folder.$comment: ZenFolder.mjs's 27x27 layered folder SVG and zen-folder-icon.inc.css: 300ms cubic-bezier(0.42,0,0,1), opposing 16deg skews, 0.85 scale. Colors follow zen-folders.css workspace-accent mixes.

glass.$comment: Performance and steady Quality chrome use a static tint and specular rim (no GPU passes). Quality surfaces over the page refract a live host copy with the Kube Searchbox filter, blurred at half resolution. Distances are DIPs.
